title: GET /api/orders/{orderId} returns any order without buyer/ownership scoping (IDOR)
owner_hint: no CODEOWNERS entry; top committer: Erin McLaughlin / Srushti; component: Ordering.API/
rationale: Threads the JWT subject into the query: IOrderQueries.GetOrderAsync(int id, string userId) with predicate o.Id == id && o.Buyer.IdentityGuid == userId (same pattern as GetOrdersFromUserAsync); endpoint resolves the sub via the existing IIdentityService; missing/empty sub fails closed as 404.
variants_checked: GetOrdersFromUserAsync already scoped; GetCardTypesAsync static lookup; OrderRepository.GetAsync command-side flows untouched (separate cancel/ship findings); no other IOrderQueries.GetOrderAsync callers.
bypass_considered: Foreign id enumeration, empty sub, non-integer ids all fail closed; identity comes only from the authenticated principal.
test_note: New Get_order_scopes_query_to_caller_identity in tests/Ordering.UnitTests/Application/OrdersWebApiTest.cs plus updated mocks for the new signature.
review_reason: Root-cause fix at the data-access layer matching the codebase's own scoping pattern; server-derived identity only; tests updated and a scoping regression test added.
